limitations: This reuses known classes, ratings and requests. No held-out or independent human-adjudication claim.
Native hub retrieval measures degree ranking, not a validated god-object classifier. Missing rows are not negative classifier decisions; unlabeled hubs do not establish precision.
The pre-cache release baseline also completes CloudStack. Recovery depends on build profile and larger artifact admission, and cannot be attributed solely to the SQL cache.

The CloudStack Compass graph is freshly produced by the cache candidate; the Eclipse Compass graph is the original frozen partial graph. Both are queried with the same release server, with producer/server provenance kept separate.
Partial-graph warnings, unavailable cases, ambiguous labels and query failures remain explicit. Source-assisted resolution/neighbor diagnostics cannot replace native ranking scores.
Identical API request limits do not equalize graph coverage: frozen Graphify skipped all 119 CloudStack SQL files. No controlled tool-speed ranking follows.
Graph consistency and exact declaration coordinates do not prove source-edge correctness, complete extraction, responsibility synthesis, authored explanation quality or functional communities.

coverageDisclosure.interpretation: The frozen Graphify installation reported skipping all SQL files and partially extracting other files with syntax errors.
